name: Digital Accessibility Compliance (ADA Title III / Sec 508 / EAA)
description: Compliance framework for the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA Title III), Rehabilitation Act Section 508, European Accessibility Act (EAA Directive (EU) 2019/882), and WCAG 2.1 AA / 2.2 AA standards, covering VPAT (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template) generation, screen reader testing, and keyboard navigation.

checklists.name: Digital Accessibility (ADA / Sec 508 / EAA) Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for WCAG 2.1 AA success criteria, Section 508, and EAA requirements.

items.statement: All interactive elements, buttons, and form inputs are navigable using keyboard key events (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space) without keyboard traps (WCAG 2.1.1).
Non-text content (images, icons) has descriptive alt text or aria-hidden='true' for decorative elements (WCAG 1.1.1).
Text and interactive controls meet 4.5:1 minimum color contrast ratio (3:1 for large text) against background colors (WCAG 1.4.3).
Screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) accurately announce page titles, headings (H1-H6 hierarchy), landmark roles, and live region updates (WCAG 1.3.1).
Accessibility Conformance Report (VPAT 2.4) is completed, signed, and published for public procurement.

reviewGates.name: Digital Accessibility Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Accessibility Lead confirms that screen reader audits, keyboard navigation, and VPAT documents satisfy ADA Section 508 & EAA standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the accessibility evaluation confirm full WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508 VPAT compliance?
